reason: The determinant-3 monoclinic cell, Z = 2, and a rutile-derived Co-anion framework are plausible, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable Rwp was supplied; the trace's restrained GSAS-II fits remain at Rwp about 10.5-10.6%, with very poor relative agreement in the weak/superstructure region (reported regional R about 88-92%). Cu Kalpha data provide little O/F contrast, and two submitted P21 orderings are essentially tied, so their coordinates and element ordering are not resolved. Moreover, the trajectory imposed a rutile-derived P21 model and compared only three P21 O-ordering classes, without instantiating the P1, P-1, Pc, or materially different framework possibilities it identified; even the omitted third P21 class had a reflection-amplitude cost comparable to a submitted class. The chemistry and bond lengths are broadly plausible, but that supports the average framework rather than the submitted symmetry, coordinates, or ordering. Another scientifically motivated solution attempt is warranted.
